source: claude-code subagent (viewed all 5 contact sheets + profile + transcript)
summary: A 34-minute 'pov' diary of a working holiday in Bali/Lombok with business partners and friends. It opens on a ~30 s music-led lead-in (snorkelling, a dark villa, a sunset silhouette) whose shots recur near the end, then settles into captioned conversation in a co-working space. The body alternates business talk (a new venture reveal, a standing revenue/'building in public' update in front of a hillside window, a team video call) with leisure: boat trips, gym, villa inspections, tennis, cliff-jumping. Yellow condensed time cards ('3PM', 'NEXT MORNING') mark days, and burned-in captions run throughout. It closes on a boat in a straw hat with a toast and 'see you in the next one'.
hook_analysis: Short visual lead-in rather than a spoken claim: 0:00-0:30 shows snorkel gear on a boat, a silhouetted villa interior and a sunset silhouette, under a song (captions transcribe 'Fly Me to the Moon' lyrics). Several images (snorkel 0:10 ~ 31:04, sunset silhouette 0:30 ~ 27:26) reappear later, so it works as a teaser of the payoff. Speech arrives at ~0:04 but the first chapter is conversational, so the hook is mood plus title premise, not a stated stake.
narrative_arc: Chronological multi-day diary with chapters: intro chat -> venture reveal (2:09) -> Lombok boat day -> standing business update (7:56-10:35) -> gym -> villa/property inspection (12:34-17:41) -> team call (18:21-21:49) -> leisure/tennis -> 'NEXT MORNING' travel day with flight, forest swim -> sunset reflection on starting a business (27:16-28:46) -> boat/snorkel finale and toast. Business beats and fun beats alternate every few minutes; the resolution is a spoken reflection on work-life balance.
camera_and_composition: Mostly handheld wide-angle: low-angle selfies under a boat canopy (4:28-6:47), over-the-shoulder group shots, a locked-off medium of the creator standing against a bright window with hills (7:56-10:35) that leaves the face partly silhouetted. Laptop screens of a video call shot straight-on (18:21-20:50). Occasional rounded-corner 'film frame' inserts (0:10, 14:43, 16:12). Exact camera moves and cuts are not observable at storyboard resolution; motion-blurred frames at 14:53 and 17:51 suggest whip moves between scenes.
color_and_grade: Warm, slightly muted naturalistic grade (profile warmth 0.064, saturation 0.34); overcast Lombok greens and creams, warm wood interiors, deep orange sunset silhouettes (27:16-28:46). Window shots are allowed to blow out rather than be relit.
sound_and_music: Speech covers ~88% of runtime at ~131 wpm. Music is a bed under the opening (song lyrics captioned) and short speech-free passages (0:40-1:27 per profile, 14:47-15:01, 17:41-17:55, 23:21-23:35). Caption markers include applause and laughter. Audio itself not available.
what_to_borrow: Open on 20-30 s of music and strong images pulled from later in the film, then drop into casual talk
Bold yellow condensed time/day cards ('3PM', 'NEXT MORNING') to orient a multi-day edit
Alternate a work beat with a leisure beat every few minutes so talk-heavy sections breathe
Burned-in captions for overlapping group chatter
Bookend with matching imagery (sunset, snorkel) so the ending feels like a payoff of the opening
what_to_avoid_copying: Three-minute standing talking head against a blown-out window (7:56-10:35) - expose for the face or cover with b-roll
Revenue and business-performance monologues that only make sense for an entrepreneur audience
Screen-recorded video calls as long scenes - visually static
